raw: Act 3, Scene 4 — A Room in Capulet’s House
Enter Capulet, Lady Capulet and Paris.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Things have fallen out, sir, so unluckily
That we have had no time to move our daughter.
Look you, she lov’d her kinsman Tybalt dearly,
And so did I. Well, we were born to die.
’Tis very late; she’ll not come down tonight.
I promise you, but for your company,
I would have been abed an hour ago.

gemma4_gloss.en: Things have happened badly, sir.
We did not have enough time to move our daughter.
Look, she loved her kinsman Tybalt dearly.
And so did I.
Well, we were born to die.
It is very late.
She will not come down tonight.
I promise you that only because of your company.
I would have been in bed an hour ago.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
These times of woe afford no tune to woo.
Madam, good night. Commend me to your daughter.

gemma4_gloss.en: These sad times are not good for courting.
Good night, Madam.
Give my regards to your daughter.

speaker: LADY CAPULET
raw:
I will, and know her mind early tomorrow;
Tonight she’s mew’d up to her heaviness.

gemma4_gloss.en: I will do that and find out her thoughts early tomorrow.
Tonight she is locked away in her sadness.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Sir Paris, I will make a desperate tender
Of my child’s love. I think she will be rul’d
In all respects by me; nay more, I doubt it not.
Wife, go you to her ere you go to bed,
Acquaint her here of my son Paris’ love,
And bid her, mark you me, on Wednesday next,
But, soft, what day is this?

gemma4_gloss.en: Sir Paris, I will make a desperate offer of my child's love.
I think she will be ruled by me in all respects.
No, I do not doubt it.
Wife, go to her before you go to bed.
Tell her about my son Paris's love.
And tell her, pay attention to me, on Wednesday next.
But, wait, what day is this?
Monday, my lord.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Monday! Ha, ha! Well, Wednesday is too soon,
A Thursday let it be; a Thursday, tell her,
She shall be married to this noble earl.
Will you be ready? Do you like this haste?
We’ll keep no great ado,—a friend or two,
For, hark you, Tybalt being slain so late,
It may be thought we held him carelessly,
Being our kinsman, if we revel much.
Therefore we’ll have some half a dozen friends,
And there an end. But what say you to Thursday?

gemma4_gloss.en: Monday! Ha, ha!
Well, Wednesday is too soon.
Let it be a Thursday.
Tell her it is a Thursday.
She shall be married to this noble earl.
Will you be ready?
Do you like this haste?
We will not have a big celebration.
Only one or two friends will come.
Because Tybalt was killed so late, people might think we did not care about him.
They might think we were careless because he was our kinsman if we celebrate too much.
Therefore, we will have about six friends.
And that is the end of it.
But what do you say to Thursday?

speaker: PARIS
raw: My lord, I would that Thursday were tomorrow.

gemma4_gloss.en: My lord, I wish that Thursday were tomorrow.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Well, get you gone. A Thursday be it then.
Go you to Juliet ere you go to bed,
Prepare her, wife, against this wedding day.
Farewell, my lord.—Light to my chamber, ho!
Afore me, it is so very very late that we
May call it early by and by. Good night.

gemma4_gloss.en: Well, go now.
Let it be a Thursday then.
Go to Juliet before you go to bed.
Prepare her, wife, for this wedding day.
Goodbye, my lord.
Bring a light to my chamber!
It is so very late that we can call it early in a moment.
Good night.
